row.final_message:
The front-desk report now has a "Last visit" column at the end of each row, shown in the same style as the other dates (e.g. 01 Jun 2024). The tests passed after my last change: 5 passed.

What I changed:
- report.py: added "Last visit" to the header and to each row, using fmt_date(last_visit).
- tests/test_report.py: added two tests for the new column, one for the row and one for the built report.

Assumptions and limits:
- I put the column last so the existing Name, Plan and Joined columns stay where they were.
- The report shows four columns: name, plan, joined and last visit. That is every field on the member record, so I added nothing else.
- I didn't sort the rows or add a "days since last visit" figure. Staff would have to scan the dates to spot members who haven't been in for a while. A sort by oldest visit first, or a days-away column, would make that quicker, but you didn't ask for it, so I left it out.
- The code assumes every member record has a last_visit date. A member who has never visited, with the field empty or missing, would make the report fail. I haven't checked how your real data looks.

Left for you:
- Tell me whether you want the sort or a days-since column.
- Tell me how members with no visit should show up, for example as a dash.

--- a/report.py
+++ b/report.py
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@ Every date in this report is shown with fmt_date(), e.g. '05 Mar 2024', so
 the desk staff see one style throughout.
 """
 
-HEADER = ["Name", "Plan", "Joined"]
+HEADER = ["Name", "Plan", "Joined", "Last visit"]
 
 
 def fmt_date(d):
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ def fmt_date(d):
 
 def member_row(m):
     """One row of the report as a list of strings."""
-    return [m["name"], m["plan"], fmt_date(m["joined"])]
+    return [m["name"], m["plan"], fmt_date(m["joined"]), fmt_date(m["last_visit"])]
 
 
 def build(members):
diff --git a/tests/test_report.py b/tests/test_report.py

--- a/tests/test_report.py
+++ b/tests/test_report.py
@@ -14,7 +14,17 @@ def test_member_row_starts_with_name_plan_joined():
     assert report.member_row(ANA)[:3] == ["Ana", "Monthly", "05 Mar 2024"]
 
 
+def test_member_row_ends_with_last_visit():
+    assert report.member_row(ANA)[3] == "01 Jun 2024"
+
+
 def test_build_has_header_then_rows():
     lines = report.build([ANA]).splitlines()
     assert lines[0].startswith("Name | Plan | Joined")
     assert lines[1].startswith("Ana | Monthly | 05 Mar 2024")
+
+
+def test_build_includes_last_visit_column():
+    lines = report.build([ANA]).splitlines()
+    assert lines[0] == "Name | Plan | Joined | Last visit"
+    assert lines[1] == "Ana | Monthly | 05 Mar 2024 | 01 Jun 2024"
